# Draft:Plenty of King

Plenty of King is a film. The film includes a fat white man in blackface depicting a rule and dancers from the Ubangi Club in Harlem, New York City. The Ubangi Club was open from 1934 to 1937. Gladys Alberta Bentley performed at it. It was at 131st Street and 7th Avenue where the Harlem Club and Harlem Tavern had been. The Smithsonian has a photo from the club. There was also an Ubangi Club in Seattle. It was an L.O.L. Production. It was written by Harry Nemo. Soundies executive William Forest Crouch refused to release it.
